before_times: Which lawyer or firm? The customer or their AI names one. Rosie never searches or suggests.
What kind of matter: family, a will or trust, a contract, papers you were served, or something else. Only the kind, no details.
In the office, by video or by phone? For video or phone: which state will you be in?
A visit at your place: a home, a hospital or a care home?
after_time: Anything that helps the visit, like an interpreter or a step-free way in. No case details.
For a signing: is the draft the firm sent ready, and can you meet the lawyer alone?
secure_page_only: Full name, and any other names used
Names only of the other people in the matter, like a spouse, the other side, or family (for the conflict check)
Is it safe to text and email you? If not, how should the firm reach you?
A tick: Rosie isn't a law firm, and the lawyer isn't yours until they agree in writing
A tick: the consult fee, and how it's paid
Only after the check clears: questions for the lawyer (optional)
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult books for themselves. Another adult may book for a parent or a spouse, but the person the matter is about gives their own names and yes on the secure page, and meets the lawyer alone. A teen's consult: a parent books.

stop: someone is hurting or threatening the customer right now
go_on: abuse, or fear of a partner, a family member or a caregiver
being pushed to sign or change a will

what_rosie_says.abuse or fear: If you're in danger, call 911. The National Domestic Violence Hotline is 1-800-799-7233, any time. The booking goes on, and Rosie asks how it's safe to reach the customer.
what_rosie_says.pushed to sign: The lawyer meets you alone first. The booking goes on.

prep: Bring any court papers you got, and a short list of questions.
A signing: have a photo ID and the draft the firm sent, and be ready to meet the lawyer alone.
required: The conflict check, before every new matter books: Priya, the paralegal, or the lawyer named checks the names on the secure page against the firm's records (clients, past would-be clients and other sides), and replies Clear, Conflict or Need more.
The time stays saved for the check, up to 1 business day (the firm's setting). No answer by then: the request ends, and nothing is owed.
A moved booking, or a follow-up on the same matter, keeps its check: same people, same matter.
A home or hospital signing: the papers are drafted first, after a consult, and two witnesses and any notary are booked with the lawyer.

skills: Notary work: a notary's own commission
staff.licenses_or_certificates: Each lawyer's active license in each state they take matters in. A video or phone consult is offered only with a lawyer licensed in the state the customer is in that day.
staff.supervision: A paralegal or office manager may run the desk and the conflict check, but never gives legal advice and never holds a consult.
staff.who_oks: The conflict check: Priya, the paralegal, or the lawyer named. Sam OKs prices made for one customer. Sam's answer wins.
staff.stand_in: Only another lawyer at the same firm, offered by the firm and picked by the customer by name. Rosie never suggests one.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult books for themselves. Another adult may book for a parent or a spouse, but the person the matter is about gives their own names and yes on the secure page, and meets the lawyer alone. A teen's consult: a parent books.
children_and_age.minors_texts: A parent books a teen's consult, and the texts go to the parent.

visit.check_in: At the office: the code at the front desk. Video or phone: the lawyer asks for the code at the start. At a home or hospital: the code at the door, then the lawyer checks the signer's photo ID.
visit.done: The code, or DONE. A signing's DONE comes once every page is signed, witnessed and notarized.
visit.changes_at_visit: Extra time or a document review is priced before it's done. A second consult is its own visit. The case itself is never booked in Rosie.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: Always: each lawyer's own license to practice, active and in good standing, in the state of the customer's matter. The firm: a registration where the state's rules require one. Each notary: their own commission.
license.who: Each lawyer; the firm where the state's rules require it; each notary.
license.ask: Each lawyer's bar number at sign-up or in their invite reply. The firm's registration where the state form asks. Each notary's commission number and end date.
license.insurance: Malpractice insurance on file, or shown to customers, where the state's rules require it; the amount comes from the state form.

never_in_a_text: what the matter is about, beyond the kind picked
why a conflict check didn't clear

pf.visit: a conflict found at the consult
